scope: TreeAge Pro, TreeAge Pro Web (TPWeb), PrecisionTree, and Oracle Crystal Ball. No account, trial, purchase, login, download, or non-public behavior was used.

documented_api_or_schema.detail: The reviewed public release notes and help pages do not document a public programming API or stable file/schema specification.

documented_methods_and_features: Markov-model calibration against clinical survival data
correlated distributions for PSA and patient simulation

documented: 2025 Release 2 distribution wizard changed the default probability-distribution variance
2026 Release 2 adds convergence/progress plots for calibration
simulation dashboard graphs with graph/export options
2025 Release 2 web output can save graph images and Excel reports

integrations: documentation says distribution parameters can be generated from SAS, Stata, and R

performance_or_service_limits.detail: No desktop performance limit was found in the reviewed public material.

rights_availability_maintenance.rights: proprietary; public source reuse not established
rights_availability_maintenance.maintenance: vendor licensing page says only the latest version is supported and active maintenance provides updates/support

correction_recommendations: Replace the inventory's unverified-current-release label with the time-bounded public pin 'TreeAge Pro 2026, Release 2'; it remains mutable, not an immutable build pin.
Do not claim a documented public API, file schema, reproducible numerical implementation, or desktop performance limit.
Keep proprietary/editor parity excluded; public material supports feature discovery, not independent executable reproduction.

products.identity: TPWeb, hosted sharing and analysis service for TreeAge Pro models

documented_api_or_schema.detail: No public API, OpenAPI document, import/export schema, or versioned service contract was found in reviewed vendor pages.

documented_methods_and_features: licensed modeler uploads a prepared TreeAge Pro model
reviewers view model structure, edit designated inputs, and run pre-set analyses
documented shared types: decision trees, Markov models, patient simulation, partitioned survival
documented analyses: cost-effectiveness, Markov cohort, microsimulation, tornado diagrams, PSA

documented: desktop modeler chooses editable numeric inputs and executable analyses
warning when an item selected as a web input does not appear to be a model input
TreeAge 2025 Release 2 notes say users can save graph images and Excel reports for web model outputs
vendor page links a publicly shared model example

integrations: TreeAge Pro desktop upload and link sharing

performance_or_service_limits.caveat: The vendor describes ongoing new functionality; these limits are historical documentation and not asserted current.

rights_availability_maintenance.rights: terms state modeler retains ownership and grants TreeAge a service-performance licence; uploader must have rights to publish uploaded model
rights_availability_maintenance.availability: viewer login required; current vendor page states no separate TPWeb licence is required but the upload/sharing feature is included with active TreeAge Pro licence
rights_availability_maintenance.maintenance: TreeAge release notes document continuing TPWeb enhancements

accessibility_security.security: terms prohibit bypassing security features/access controls; technical security controls are otherwise unknown

correction_recommendations: Record TPWeb as a hosted, login-gated service, not a public API or open product.
Keep the January 2024 quotas clearly historic; do not represent them as current SLAs.
Do not infer that all desktop analyses or arbitrary inputs are executable online: modeler must pre-designate them.

products.identity: Lumivero PrecisionTree probabilistic decision analysis software for Microsoft Excel

documented_api_or_schema.detail: Vendor documents the PrecisionTree Developer Kit for automation/customization with Excel VBA. No public stable API reference or model-file schema was found in reviewed material.

documented_methods_and_features: logic/reference nodes, linked trees, custom utility functions, influence diagrams

documented: v8.3 version history says sensitivity-analysis maximum inputs increased from 16 to 32
default sensitivity-input steps changed from 10 to 11 so base value is included
risk-profile, two-way-sensitivity, tornado, spider, policy-suggestion, and strategy-region reports/graphs
copy tree image to clipboard for Word, PowerPoint, or other reporting applications
Policy Suggestion report has a benefit-of-correct-choice column
Professional: up to 1,000 nodes per tree
Industrial: unlimited nodes

rights_availability_maintenance.availability: vendor product page offers demo/purchase routes; DecisionTools Suite page describes Windows-only compatibility
rights_availability_maintenance.maintenance: DecisionTools subscription information says upgrades, maintenance updates, compatibility fixes, patches, and support are included during subscription

correction_recommendations: Replace broad 'public product page' version identity with the qualified mutable v8.3 documentation-path pin, while retaining no claim of current release.
PrecisionTree supports risk attitudes through utility functions, but public evidence does not establish EUI, CEI, BPI, SPI, or constructed-scale information prices; retain adjacent classification.
Do not promote the Developer Kit to a documented stable API/schema claim without its public reference material.

products.identity: Oracle Crystal Ball spreadsheet forecasting and risk-analysis product

documented_api_or_schema.detail: Reviewed Oracle guides document Excel-cell model elements and workbook use, but no public programming API or stable schema contract was identified.

documented_methods_and_features: assumption, decision-variable, and forecast spreadsheet cells
decision-table tool testing one or two decision variables across ranges

documented: chart redraw default is 0.5 seconds
demo-speed default maximum is 10 trials/second
OptQuest defaults are 1,000 simulations and 5 minutes
32-bit emulation has 1–1.5 GB memory limits
forecast/trend/overlay chart analysis
Reference and Examples Guide contains examples, formulas, and reference material
cell definitions can be copied/pasted/cleared using Crystal Ball commands

integrations: Oracle Smart View / Enterprise Performance Management Connector
OptQuest with Crystal Ball Decision Optimizer

documented: 32-bit emulation 1–1.5 GB memory constraint
approximately 160 MB disk required
speed settings describe chart/window suppression and foreground Excel as faster for large models
performance_or_service_limits.caveat: These apply to the documented 11.1.2.4.850/.900-era requirements, not an asserted current product.

rights_availability_maintenance.rights: Oracle guide says use/copy/reproduction/distribution are restricted by licence and reverse engineering is prohibited except where law requires interoperability
rights_availability_maintenance.availability: public Oracle documentation; executable commercial availability/current support not verified

accessibility_security.accessibility: User guide refers to an Oracle Crystal Ball Accessibility Guide, but conformance details were not audited

correction_recommendations: Retain exclusion from direct VOI mapping: decision tables and optimisation do not establish a VOI estimator.
Use the explicit 11.1.2.4.850 manual pin rather than 'unknown' when discussing the audited documentation; do not call it current.
Do not claim public API/schema, modern support, or current performance characteristics.

global_limitations: All vendor product pages and hosted help are mutable unless an explicit release/version is named.
No claim in this artifact establishes source availability, reproducibility, interoperability, accessibility conformance, security posture, or a licence to reuse models/data.
Absence means not verified from the reviewed public vendor sources, not that the feature necessarily does not exist behind a login or licence.
